description: Use when an agent must mint a secret and be able to justify its strength: strong random passwords from the platform CSPRNG, returned with their entropy in bits so the strength is a number and not an opinion. Four alphabets, one with no look-alike characters for anything a human has to read back or dictate. Do not use for ids that only need to be unique (/v1/util/uuid). $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

alphabet.description: alnum | legible | hex | completo. Defaults to legible.

count.description: How many to generate, 1-50. Defaults to 1.

name: random_password
title: Password generator
